benchmark: OAEI Conference track, OntoFarm, reference alignment ra1 (21 pairs, 7 ontologies)

protocol.selection: mutual-best 1:1 over all same-kind cross pairs, then confidence threshold
protocol.micro: absolute TP/FP/FN summed over the 21 pairs
protocol.macro: mean of per-pair P/R/F1 over pairs that have reference correspondences of that kind
protocol.threshold_selection_caveat: best-threshold / best-config rows are selected on the test set and are optimistic
protocol.cross_validation: leave-one-pair-out (21 folds) and leave-one-ontology-out (7 folds): the grid point with the best micro-F1 M3 on the training pairs is applied to the held-out pairs, whose TP/FP/FN are summed

published.aggregation: micro (absolute TP/FP/FN across all 21 test cases)
published.note: ra1 is the original crisp reference alignment; the organisers' headline table is rar2-M3 (consistency- and conservativity-repaired), which we do not vendor and therefore do not report numbers against.  OAEI 2024 published only rar2-M3 for the Conference track.
